title: A project in the runbun.dev gallery

description.description: One line under the name: what the project shows.

kind.description: starter: a small project to build on. example: shows a framework or feature.

order.description: Position within its kind (then by name); lower comes first.

tags.description: The frameworks and libraries it is built on (React, Elysia, SQLite), not Bun's own APIs. The first one with a logo gives the card its icon (else Bun's).

repo.description: A public GitHub repo (owner/repo, owner/repo@ref or a github.com URL) to open instead of files here: the folder then holds only this file.
